# Test issuegraph blocked command
issuegraph init --prefix test

# Create first issue
issuegraph create 'First issue'
cp stdout first.txt
exec sh -c 'grep -oE "test-[a-z0-9]+" first.txt > first_id.txt'

# Create second issue that depends on first
exec sh -c 'issuegraph create "Second issue" --deps $(cat first_id.txt)'
cp stdout second.txt

# Check for blocked issues
issuegraph blocked
stdout 'test-'
